name: ZOIA
about: Empress's modular-style multi-effects pedal, whose patches are built from modules on a grid.
source: Empress ZOIA User Manual, firmware 1.13, pp. 26-31 (starred CC, Config menu, MIDI); MIDI module descriptions at https://empresseffects.com/products/zoia ; https://empresseffects.com/cdn/shop/files/ZOIA_Manual_1_dot_13.pdf
notes: ZOIA has no fixed CC map: put a MIDI CC In module in your patch for each knob and set its controller to 102-117 (CC In 1 = 102 ... CC In 16 = 117, CCs the MIDI spec leaves undefined; the manual reserves only CC 60-63 for engage/bypass and buttons). Set Config > Midi Ch (program changes and bypass) and Starred CC ch to the channel used here, and Control Port to MIDI if using the TRS jack. Patches are numbered 0-63. Tempo follows a MIDI Clock In module.
